records.issue_text: Missing test coverage for the new multi-destination-calendar/collective-event fan-out logic in EventManager.ts despite destinationCalendar changing from a single object to an array across many call sites
records.rationale: The diff substantially rewrites EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents and updateAllCalendarEvents (multi-destination loops, DB credential fetches, per-reference fan-out) and changes the destinationCalendar contract from a single object to an array across ~15 call sites, yet the only test change is an e2e fixture update (destinationCalendar: null -> []) in webhook.e2e.ts — no tests cover the new collective-event fan-out or multi-calendar create/update paths. This is a concrete, substantive test-coverage gap for newly added nontrivial logic, not a generic 'add more tests' complaint.
